en.marketHeading: What is actually different about marketing across {city}
market: Halifax is the only large metro in Atlantic Canada, and that gives {city} businesses a role their population does not suggest. Specialist firms here routinely serve New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island and Newfoundland because there is nowhere closer to serve them from. If that describes you, then targeting {city} alone is cutting off a large part of your real market, and the fix is a wider geography rather than a bigger budget.

The province splits into a metro market and a set of much smaller ones. Advertising economics in Halifax look like a mid-sized Canadian city. In Cape Breton, the Valley or the South Shore, volumes are thin enough that paid search sometimes cannot carry a campaign on its own, and being the obvious answer organically matters more than outbidding anyone.

The core industries here, {industries}, sell on credibility and to buyers who research carefully. That is a poor fit for aggressive advertising and a very good fit for publishing work that demonstrates you know what you are doing. It is also why AI visibility is worth more here than the market size implies, because a chatbot asked for an Atlantic Canadian specialist will name a very short list.

en.servicesHeading: Three ways to grow a {city} business, run by one accountable person
en.servicesIntro: Same three services everywhere I work. What changes in {city} is that the right geography is usually the region rather than the province.

services.title: Google Ads Management
services.body: In {city} that starts with deciding honestly whether you sell provincially or regionally, then targeting to match. Account structure, then cutting spend on searches that were never going to convert. Outside Halifax I will tell you when the volume does not justify the channel.

services.title: SEO Consulting
services.body: Usually the better first investment here, because Atlantic buyers research and because ranking for a regional term is realistic in a way that ranking nationally is not. Technical fixes first, then the pages that answer your customers' actual questions.

services.title: AIO Consulting
services.body: Being the business ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews name when someone asks for a specialist in Atlantic Canada. The shortlist is genuinely short in this region, which makes this the best value of the three right now.

area.citiesBody: Halifax has its own page covering what is specific to that market, including how much of the region it serves.
area.districtsBody: I take on clients throughout {districts}. Everything is run remotely over video and email, so where in the province you are makes no difference to the work or the price.
area.nearbyBody: Plenty of good {city} businesses are a long way from the capital. I work with businesses in {nearby} on the same terms.

faq.q: Do you have an office in {city}?
faq.a: No. I am based in Toronto and work from home, so there is no {city} office and I am not going to imply there is. Everything is run remotely over video and email, which is how I run every account.

faq.q: Should we market to Nova Scotia or to Atlantic Canada?
faq.a: Whichever one you actually sell to, and for a lot of specialist firms here the honest answer is the region. If customers in Moncton, Charlottetown or St. John's already buy from you, then provincial targeting is leaving your best prospects out of the campaign for no reason.

faq.q: We are outside Halifax. Does any of this work for us?
faq.a: SEO and AIO usually do. Paid search sometimes does not, because the search volume in the smaller parts of the province can be too thin to build a campaign on. I will tell you which situation you are in rather than selling you all three.

faq.q: Do you work with agencies here?
faq.a: Yes. Some Atlantic agencies bring me in on Google Ads or AIO work they do not run in-house, white labelled or not depending on what you prefer, and some agency owners hire me for their own marketing.
Google Ads management is $1,500 a month plus your ad spend. SEO consulting is $1,200 a month. AIO consulting is $1,800 one time. No setup fees and no long contract.
